Q: Who is zainalidev?

Q: What makes Zain Ali Developer unique?

Q: What is Vibe Coding according to Zain Ali?
A: Vibe Coding is an AI-first engineering paradigm where human developers operate at the high-leverage level of architecture, intent, and visual taste, while specialized frontier AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) execute low-level syntax drafting and boilerplate assembly in real-time flow state.
